name: Communication Mod
description: Structured state/action bridge with event semantics, local Cursed Tome flow, full run-lifecycle control, card reward skip and Singing Bowl handling, and pre-rolled chest facts. Adds full visible shop stock/prices with legacy action-index alignment, selected grid cards and permanent card values, seed-group metadata, legal potion use/discard, configurable port, an opt-in isolated real-engine shop-generation probe, guarded boss relic pickup with Astrolabe grid recognition, and deferred boss relic landing so transform/purge card grids open after the boss relic screen closes. Publishes permanent base damage/block/magic values before combat initialization for visible-deck routing and previews The Library's 20-card offer and Knowing Skull's next colorless card without advancing game RNG.
